verdict.rationale: Honeybadger auto-resolves unresolved errors when a deploy is recorded, and lets you choose which error events trigger notifications. Together these imply that an error returning after a release would resurface as a selectable notification event. However, the evidence never explicitly documents a 'reoccurred/regressed' alert type or how it is distinguished from new-error notifications. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a resolved-error-reoccurred notification event, evidence that regressions are labeled distinctly from new issues, linkage of the regression to a specific release version, independent or hands-on corroboration.
